XIII. Ego Wocho de Rosenberch sciens ineuitabile omnibus esse mori, dum essem in extremis diebus uite mee, compos tamen adhuc mentis mee, subscripta fieri decreui et uolo ab omnibus amicis meis inmutabiliter obseruari. Notum sit vniuersis, quibus presens littera fuerit demonstrata, quod Hedewigi uxori mee dilecte disposui et plane dedi uniuersa bona mea, tam res mobiles quam omnes rcdditus meos, ut utatu'r eis et habeat una cum pueris meis libere sicut uelit tam diu, ut caste in sede uiduali curauerit residere. Si uero volun- tarie a pueris suis separari et diuidi uoluerit et caste absque marito uixeril, habeat Pudeiauz cum attinentiis suis, Strobnitz cum perti- nentiis suis, et WezzaI cum cum (sic) omnibus que ad hoc pertinent, et Gemundam habeat tantum pro peccunia ut ei primo fuerat obli gata, et dotem que ei in primo contractu sponsalium a me fuerat assignat;i. Illa uero bona citra Gemundam que denariis meis redemi, domine de Potendorf reddo integraliter et relaxo. Si autem uxor mea uiro alii uiro (sic) nubere uoluerit, Strobnitz cum attinentiis suis et WezzaI cum omnibus, que ad hoc pertinent, et Gemundam et dotem suam cum curia supra Swant habeat et recedat. Item litem Fontes. Al)thl¡f. II. Bd. XXIII. 2 18 que inter me et patruum meum Budewoy uertitur de Schinta, sic decido, quod ipse ad claustrum in Slegel det pro anime mee remedio, si mihi cedat de iure, aut illuc det pro anime sue remedio, si de iu're sibi cedat, aut metipse super animam suam retineat; hoc eins con- scientie sic relinquo. Item peto et inuoco gratiam domini mei regis, ut ducentas marcas argenti quas canonicis Pragensibus dedi, faciat restitui et triginta marcas de eadem recipiat peccunia, quia triginta marcas de peccunia comiti de Wirtenberch danda de Styr. iam reeepi. De residua autem peccunia predicatoribus de Auzt, quicquid ipsis soluere teneor, persoluatur; et post hec domine Cristine de Praga, quidquid superfluum fuerit, tribuatur. Item Hermanno de Lettowitz do maius Pomerswitz, ut michi ignoscat, quod dominum meum regem pro ipso non ammonui, ut sperabat. Vlrico etiam de Hohenpurch minus Pomerswitz dedi et eum a bonis meis aliis penitus exclusi. Item Borute uillam meam Ruzin assigno nomine pignoris pro peccunia, quam adhuc sibi soluere debui, sicut Zwatemiro meo militi bene constat, aut reddat pueris meis peccuniam quam ¡psi dedi, si uillam uoluerit retinere. Item pueris sororis mee do Pritschit in cambium pro Dobricho, si habere uoluerint uel dent domino Jerusio compatri meo, et reddet ipsis Dobricho. Pro eo autem quod usus sum bonis eorum, do eis Yletitz et illas duas uillas, quas haben t Zwatebor et Petrus. Item domino Hoztizlao pro triginta tribus marcis argenti, quas ipsis soluere debui, Paschitz dedi, si tantum ualeat, si uero non ualeat, tantum residuum de bonis meis illi persoluatur. Et Benate duas hubas in Treboni, que mel soluunt, pro decem marcis argenti et in pignore assignaui. Item Alberoni de Rotenstain duas maiores uillas supra Swant contuli, ut habeat a pueris meis in feodo. Curiam autem et agros contra Sumerowe et interiores agros contra Yben- stain usque ad metas Boemie do vxori mee. Item uolo, ut Schecow tres ille uille uendantur domino Predote pro centum septuaginta marcis, et soluatur inde fratribus de Sancto Clemente, si quinque maree auri ipsis non sint integraliter persolute. Et quinque maree auri soluantur inde pueris domini Bawari secundum conscientiam domini Benisii sororii domini Bawari et domini Predote iam predicti. Et triginta maree argenti dentur inde bomini, qui pro anima mea uadat ad Pruthenos. Et uendantur uiginti maree pro XXXa talentis Wiennensibus, et XV talenta dentur in Durrenpach, et XV in Gors, et residuum ¡n Tyn et circa in villis secundum domini Hoztizlai con 19 scientiam persoluatur. Item homini de Palauia pro uiginti mareis argenti in Lcimpach dentur due hube, sed si gratiam mihi fecerif, tantum una. Item Rudigero notario vxori sue et suis beredibus dedi Kirspovm uillam libere cum omni iure, ita tamen quod inde vxori mee, dum uiuit, seruiat obsequia debita per scripturam, et tantum uiginti marcas argenti, si a pueris meis et vxore recedere uoluerit, habeat super uillam iam predictam. Item Royate camerario in Slyb- nitz tres hubas dedi, illas inquam, que iudicis fuerant, dum uiuebat. Item Cunrado de Turdeling uillam Gutenprvn, quam prius a me tenuit infeodo, in proprietatem dedi, ita tamen quod nunquam se , dum uiuit, a pueris meis seruiendo ipsis fideliter alienet; et duo molen- dina iuxta aquam Strobnitz, et quatuor bubas in Fridrichisslage eidem Cunrado pro triginta marcis crgenti obligaui uel baheat in feodo, si sibi uidebitur expedire. Item quicquid in Gunthersrevt babeo solutum, Kalhocho contuli in feodo; et reddo Andree militi suam uillam. Item ad claustrum Hohenvurt dedi Plawe, Nouum Forum, et quicquid ex ista parte Wulte Imbeo, pro anime mee remedio et suc- cessorum meorum salute et remedio animarum. Item uolo, ut Budewoy patruus meus Lohemilo det uillam unam de meis possessionibus ex altera parte Pritschitz, ubi ipsum sua discretio ammonebit. Item uolo, ut idem patruus meus Bodewoy ¡Hi militi, cuius dextrarium accepi, uillam illam assignet in pignore iterato, que prius ipsi fuerat assignata, et ille due uille reddantur ecclesie, ut est iustum, quas idem miles habet. Item uolo, ut dominus Zwatemirus pro quadraginta marcis argenti uillam meam Treboni assignet in pignore domino Borsoni, ut indultum et remissum michi sit, si ipsum in commutatione quam feci pro Strobnitz, aliqualiter defraudaui; et non multum rogetur, sed addatur ei aliquid, si quadraginta marcas beniuole ren- nuerit acceptare. Item uolo, ut Bvdewoy patruus meus pro quin- quaginta marcis argenti obliget Bozeiowitz uillam meam et distri- buatur illud argentum inter orphanos meos et orphanos fratris mei, seruos illos scilicet, quorum patres a me nulla feoda tenuerunt. Et quatuordecim equi quos frater meus reliquitin Pribenitz, distribuantur similiter inter illos, ex una parte secundum conscientiam domini Prehtelini, domini Gerberti, Cunradi de Turdeling; ex parte uero altera secundum conscientiam domini Zwatemiri, domini Predote et domini Hoztizlai, ut unicuique pro obsequii sui merito tribuatur. Item Budelao uillam meam Babenberch obligntionis titulo assignaui 3• го pro quadraginta talentis Wiennensium denariorum, quas sibi dare promisi cum uxore sua, cum eam sibi legitime copulaui. Item eidem curiam in suburbio castri Rosenberch dedi, ut in ea resideat pro purchhuta. Item Werenbardo marstellario curiam unam in Mut- scherat dedi, illam que quondam Berhtoldo carpentario seruiebat. Item Gvilloni in Emerndorf quatuor benefitia contuli iure et tytulo feodali. Item hospitalario de Pirn sex marcas denar., quas ei soluere debeo, iubeo sibi dari, et arma mea similiter sibi dedi. Monachis <lr Hohenvurt uasa mea argentea et dextrarium meum dedi. Vt autem hec suprascripta robur babeant firmitatis, presentem litteram in testi- monium scribi iussi et sigillo prioris de Petow et sigillo custodis minorum fratrum de Gretz et sigillo proprio roborari. Acta sunt autem hec presentibus fratre Gotfrido et fratre Ottone sacerdotibus ordinis predicatorum, domino Prehtelino, Cunrado offitiali, Koyta et Grillone camerariis, Rudigero notario, et aliis multis. entries.english:
4 June 1262, Gretz. Wok von Rosenberg leaves the villages of Plawe and Neudorf, his silver vessels and his riding horse to Hohenfurt in his last will.

I, Wok von Rosenberg, knowing death to be inevitable for all, while in the last days of my life but still of sound mind, have decreed the following and wish it to be observed without alteration by all my friends. Let all to whom this letter is shown know that I have assigned and given all my goods, both movable property and all my revenues, to my beloved wife Hedwig, to hold and use freely with my children as she wishes for as long as she lives chastely in widowhood. If she voluntarily wishes to separate from her children and lives chastely without a husband, she shall have Pudeiauz, Strobnitz and Wezzal with their appurtenances, Gmünd only for the money for which it was first pledged to her, and the marriage portion I assigned her at our first betrothal. I restore in full to the lady de Potendorf the property on this side of Gmünd that I redeemed with my own money. If my wife wishes to marry another man, she shall take Strobnitz and Wezzal with their appurtenances, Gmünd and her marriage portion with the farm above Swant, and depart.

I settle the dispute between me and my paternal uncle Budewoy over Schinta thus: if the right is mine, he shall give it to the monastery of Schlägl for my soul; if the right is his, he shall give it there for his own soul or keep it on his conscience. I leave this to his conscience. I ask my lord the king to have the 200 marks of silver I gave to the canons of Prague repaid and to take 30 marks from that money, since I have already received 30 marks of the money from Styria to be given to the Graf de Wirtenberch. From the rest let what I owe the Dominicans of Auzt be paid in full, and then whatever remains be given to Christine of Prague.

I give greater Pomerswitz to Hermann de Lettowitz, so that he may forgive me for not reminding my lord the king on his behalf as he had hoped. I have given lesser Pomerswitz to Ulrich de Hohenpurch and entirely excluded him from my other goods. I assign my village Ruzin to Boruta as a pledge for money I still owe him, as my knight Zwatemir well knows; or, if he wishes to retain the village, he must return to my children the money I gave him. I give my sister's children Pritschit in exchange for Dobricho if they wish to have it, or they may give it to Herr Jerusius, my compater, who will return Dobricho to them. Because I have used their property, I give them Yletitz and the two villages held by Zwatebor and Peter.

To Herr Hoztizlaus I have given Paschitz for the 33 marks of silver I owed him, if it is worth that much; otherwise the balance shall be paid from my goods. I have assigned Benata two hides in Treboni which yield honey, as a pledge for ten marks of silver. I have given Albero de Rotenstain the two larger villages above Swant to hold in fief from my children; the farm and fields towards Sumerowe and the inner fields towards Ybenstain up to the Bohemian boundary I give to my wife.

I wish the three villages of Schecow to be sold to Herr Predota for 170 marks. From the proceeds the brothers of St. Clement shall be paid if their five marks of gold have not been paid in full; five marks of gold shall also be paid to Herr Bavar's children according to the judgment of Herr Benisius, Bavar's brother-in-law, and Herr Predota. Thirty marks of silver shall be given to a man to go to Prussia for my soul. Twenty marks shall be exchanged for thirty Viennese talents, of which fifteen talents shall be paid at Durrenpach and fifteen at Gors; the remainder shall be paid at Tyn and the surrounding villages according to Herr Hoztizlaus's conscience.

For twenty marks of silver two hides at Lcimpach shall be given to the man de Palauia, but only one if he grants me that favor. I have given Rüdiger the notary, his wife and heirs the village of Kirspovm freely with full right, provided that during my wife's life he renders her the services due under the written agreement. If he wishes to leave my children and wife, he shall have only twenty marks of silver secured on that village. I have given Royata the chamberlain three hides at Slybnitz, those that belonged to the judge in his lifetime.

I have given Konrad de Turdeling the village of Gutenprvn, which he previously held from me in fief, as property, provided that during his life he never withdraws from my children but serves them faithfully. I have also pledged to him two mills beside the Strobnitz and four hides at Fridrichisslage for thirty marks of silver, or he may hold them in fief if he prefers. Whatever I hold unencumbered at Gunthersrevt I have granted to Kalhoch in fief, and I return his village to Andreas, Ritter. For the remedy of my soul and the salvation and remedy of my successors' souls I have given the monastery of Hohenvurt Plawe, Nouum Forum and everything I have on this side of the Wulta.

I wish my uncle Budewoy to give Lohemil one village from my possessions beyond Pritschitz, wherever his judgment directs. The same uncle shall again assign as a pledge to the knight whose warhorse I took the village previously assigned to him, and the two villages held by that knight shall be returned to the church as is right. Herr Zwatemir shall pledge my village Treboni to Herr Borson for forty marks of silver, so that I may be pardoned if I in any way defrauded him in the exchange I made for Strobnitz; he is not to be pressed greatly, but given something more if he refuses the forty marks in good faith.

My uncle Budewoy shall pledge my village Bozeiowitz for fifty marks of silver, and the money shall be distributed among my orphans and my brother's orphans, namely those servants whose fathers held no fiefs from me. The fourteen horses my brother left at Pribenitz shall likewise be divided among them: on one side according to the judgment of Herr Prehtelin, Herr Gerbert and Konrad de Turdeling, and on the other according to that of Herr Zwatemir, Herr Predota and Herr Hoztizlaus, so that each receives according to the merit of his service.

I have pledged my village Babenberch to Budelaus for forty talents of Viennese pennies which I promised to give him with his wife when I lawfully joined them in marriage. I have also given him a farm in the suburb of Rosenberg Castle, to reside there for castle guard. I have given Werenhard the marshal a farm at Mutscherat formerly held by Berthold the carpenter, and granted Guillo four holdings at Emerndorf in fief. I direct that the Hospitaller of Pirn be given the six marks of pennies I owe him, and I have also given him my arms. I have given the monks of Hohenvurt my silver vessels and riding horse.

To give these provisions firm force, I ordered this letter written in testimony and secured with the seals of the prior of Petow, the custodian of the Friars Minor of Gretz and myself. Done in the presence of brothers Gottfried and Otto, priests of the Dominican order; Herr Prehtelin; Konrad the official; the chamberlains Royta and Grillo; Rüdiger the notary; and many others. Given at Gretz on the day before the Nones of June in the year of grace 1262.

Three damaged seals in white wax: the first, small and hanging from a parchment strip, may show Jesus before Lazarus's tomb and bears the legend “S. Prioris Petovie”; the second hangs from a hemp cord and is otherwise like that in no. VIII; the third is small and lenticular, hangs from parchment, and shows a haloed figure perhaps seated on a donkey, with letters on either side of the head and the legend “Sigillvm Cvstodis St...”. See Millauer, p. 45, no. 6.
